svg.title: Sharing and isolation are disconnected legal choices
svg.desc: A gap scale shows a legal shared region from zero to maximum stretch, an illegal intermediate band, and a separate isolation region. A compound branch change jumps between legal endpoints.
svg.text: Two legal components of a spacing rule
Change branch and realize its geometry in one trial.
Then check neighbors, symmetry and total trench stretch.
Illustrative rule shape; smax and d require a process-specific definition.
